metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: a Nuxt 4 website foundation, a crew of subagents, a docs keeper and a mock kit.

plugins.name: web-foundation
plugins.description: Nuxt 4 website foundation: a runnable template plus skills to scaffold projects and add resources, realtime, assistant, PWA and deploy.

plugins.name: dev-crew
plugins.description: A crew of subagents for big coding tasks and for analysing large bodies of code or docs: each role on the model suited to it (plan and review on Fable or Opus, develop on Sonnet, verify on Haiku), git worktrees per area for code, every decision written to docs.

plugins.name: docs-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a project's docs/ as one folder per category and one file per topic, updated as the code changes and always listed in CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: mock-kit
plugins.description: Interactive mocks before big features: Vue 3 + Tailwind by CDN with no build, always white and styled like the project, a growing component library, browser checks and screenshots.
